travel.definition: Sum of horizontal displacement between consecutive observed poses in the same life; excludes sample gaps and respawns, includes any same-life teleport.

excavation.definition: Attempts measure issued work; command success does not prove that the agent destroyed a block.

survival.definition: Health decrease is the sum of adjacent same-life net decreases, not total damage; death count includes only lives observed at health <= 0.

dark_exposure_allowance.definition: Snapshots describe policy state, not physical dark exposure. Active samples require an acting Explore leaf; suspended or returning allowances are excluded. Counts use post-decision state; deadline instances use both before and after state.

perception_violations.reason: Decision replay and trace coverage do not audit sensor or motor hidden reads.

break_target_observations.scope: Recorded target identity and observation time only. Does not audit line of sight, light, physical reach, support reservations, sensor reads, or motor reads.

limits: Fresh spawn differs from the previous failed run; this is not a controlled before/after seed comparison.
The dedicated mushroom fixture supplies controlled before/after evidence.
Full perception audit, frozen held-out release, cutover and full game completion remain open.
